en: Black‑and‑white panoramic view of a small town railway station set in a hilly rural landscape. In the foreground are several tracks with freight wagons and open cars loaded with goods. The main station building prominently displays the word "GLASHÜTTE" on its gable. Around the station are warehouses with large painted advertisements, and multi‑storey townhouses and factories with smoking chimneys behind them. Tree‑covered hills rise in the background, giving the scene a typical Central European valley‑town appearance.
